customer: Quick question before I request an offer on my pickup. The odometer was swapped out a couple years ago, so the mileage it shows isn't right. Night shifts keep me busy, so I'd like to get this sorted in one go. What do I need to do?
agent: Thanks for letting us know. Please mention the replaced odometer when you request your offer, and at the appointment you'll mark 'not actual mileage' on the odometer statement, form NW-ODO-1. Vehicles marked 'not actual mileage' receive a reduced offer, but if you know the true mileage, bring records that show it, such as service invoices. You can find these details in our article 'Broken or replaced odometer.'
